grain_rationale: row_count is 44721 and duplicate_row_rate is 0.0, so the source carries no exact duplicate rows and each row is a distinct transaction; invoice_id (distinct_count 2330) and stock_code (distinct_count 3141) are each non-unique on their own, but their combination forms a derived identity that identifies each invoice line, and since duplicate_row_rate is 0.0 there are no exact duplicates for that identity to absorb, so no aggregation is needed.

fields.name: invoice_id
fields.description: Non-null VARCHAR invoice document code (samples '489434'-'489443') with distinct_count 2330 across 44721 rows, identifying the invoice a line belongs to; it is a dimension because it is not unique per row.

fields.name: is_cancellation
fields.description: Non-null BOOLEAN flag with distinct_values [false, true] marking whether the line is a cancellation record; it labels rows rather than measuring them, so it is a dimension.

fields.name: stock_code
fields.description: Non-null VARCHAR product code (samples '10002', '10080', '10123G') with distinct_count 3141, identifying the stock item on the line; a dimension.

fields.name: product_description
fields.description: Nullable (null_rate 0.5098%) VARCHAR free-text product description (samples such as '12 PENCIL SMALL TUBE WOODLAND'); a dimension that is occasionally missing in the source.

fields.name: quantity
fields.description: Non-null INTEGER quantity transacted on the line, ranging from -1395 to 5184 in profile samples, with negative values plausibly corresponding to cancellations; it is added across rows and is therefore a measure.

fields.name: invoiced_at
fields.description: Non-null TIMESTAMP recording when the line was invoiced, with samples resolving to the minute (e.g. 2009-12-01T07:45:00 then 07:46:00); this is the time column for the category, at minute grain.

fields.name: unit_price
fields.description: Non-null DECIMAL(10,2) unit price ranging from 0.0 to 1998.49 in samples; it is compared and aggregated across lines, so it is a measure.

fields.name: customer_id
fields.description: Nullable (null_rate 30.0664%) INTEGER identifier of the purchasing customer (samples 12346, 12349, 12358); it labels the line rather than being summed, so it is a dimension, and is missing for roughly a third of lines likely reflecting unidentified or guest purchases.

fields.name: country
fields.description: Non-null VARCHAR country associated with the invoice line (samples 'Australia', 'Belgium', 'Germany') with distinct_count 24; a dimension.

category_description: One row represents a single invoice line item: a stock-coded product entry recorded against an invoice, capturing the quantity and unit price transacted at a specific minute-resolution timestamp.
purpose: This mapping declares how the silver.silver_invoice_lines table enters the gold unified event star as the invoice_lines fact category, for consumption by the deterministic modeling engine that builds the gold models from approved mapping contracts.
usage: The mapping contract proposal is rendered to an ODCS mapping draft, validated against the frozen mapping-contract schema, checked by datacontract lint, and reviewed and edited by a human before approval; only then does the deterministic modeling engine use the approved contract to emit the gold invoice_lines fact.
limitations: The mapping does not filter, exclude, or reclassify cancellation lines flagged by is_cancellation or the negative quantities observed in samples (as low as -1395), nor does it resolve or impute the 30.0664% null rate on customer_id; such exclusions and resolutions are left to downstream consumers of the gold fact.
